observations.meaning: This observed public HTML contained navigation and an empty market count, not a verified live NFL contract feed.

limitations: No public documented authorized DraftKings Predictions live NFL contract feed was verified.
The documented vendor Betstamp feed requires credentials and presents normalized decimal/American prices; its public sample does not prove exact executable exchange quotes, fees or settlement rules.
Official standard fee terms are publicly readable. Applying them to an actual fill still requires verified venue, account pricing, quantity and execution details.
No private resource APIs, login session, geolocation bypass or customer account data was accessed.
